elements_not_encoded.reason: Pointer-only red box: 'Treat as anaphylaxis' sends the delayed-collapse patient to the anaphylaxis page (28); no rule encoded here, per the pointer-only decision.

judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded as a diagnosis rule; the red box is a pointer and the anaphylaxis page owns that logic. The delayed-collapse signs are checked for and used only as absences in the fainting rule.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A possible (or probable) Anaphylaxis rule from collapse + vaccination + any delayed-collapse sign, which would route the patient into page 28's check.

judgment_calls.decision: Task fires on Collapse AND Vaccination given (the page title).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Fire on Collapse alone and check_for Vaccination given; that fires in practice but asks vaccination questions of every collapse.

judgment_calls.topic: BP and pulse in the fainting rule
judgment_calls.decision: 'BP rapidly normal again' and 'pulse may be slow' encoded as the negation of the delayed thresholds: SBP >= 90, DBP >= 60, pulse <= 120.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave vitals out and rely only on 'no other signs or symptoms'; that fires more often.

judgment_calls.topic: Loss-of-consciousness duration and relief by lying down
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded (20 s - 1 min vs > 1 min; relieved or not by lying down/raising legs).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Brief / Prolonged loss of consciousness (finding) exist, but their SNOMED durations are undefined and do not match 1 minute.
